messages:
maria: Quick async — who owns the SDK changes for v2 streaming + the deprecation path for v1 clients? Need owners and any infra deps. CC @kevin @sarah
jonathan: i can own SDK-JS changes if eng-runtime confirms streaming frames change. what's the exact breaking?
samir: breaking = header rename from "x-rw-stream" -> "x-rw-v2-stream". Also chunk framing changes for partial final token. see snippet:
```
Accept: application/json; charset=utf-8
x-rw-v2-stream: framed
```
kevin: that's correct. eng-runtime needs to ship a compatibility shim for v1 for 30 days; shim toggled by header. I'll take runtime shim + rollout.
maria: thx. SDK-JS owner is @jonathan. SDK-Python?
sarah: I can pick up SDK-Py. timeline: finish PRs by EOD Wed, publish patch release Thu. Need a test harness for old clients; can eng-platform bake one?
jonathan: will open PR today. question: do we want an automatic fallback to non-streaming for legacy clients when shim absent?
samir: yes, fallback should be non-streaming chunked responses, same tokens but no chunked SSE. That avoids 5xx. We'll add metric `stream_compat_fallback`.
dev-bot: canary deploy for runtime:v2-shim passed in us-west-2 — 3 nodes healthy :thumbsup: 
kevin: ops: please add this dependency to rollout doc: eng-runtime shim, sdk-js PR, sdk-py PR, infra toggle flag. I'll update the handoff table.
maria: action items:
- @jonathan PR (sdk-js) by EOD
- @sarah PR (sdk-py) by EOD Wed
- @kevin runtime shim + feature flag toggle
- @samir add metric + tests
ping me when PRs are up, i'll coordinate canary windows.
jonathan: PR link: https://git.redwood.dev/sdk-js/pull/204 (draft) — notes in PR about header parser
sarah: creating draft now, will attach integration test steps.
maria: sweet. if no objections i'll mark jenkins windows for Thu 10:00 PT for canary. /cc @oncall-bot
oncall-bot: scheduled: canary-window Thu 2026-03-19 10:00 PT. Reminder 24h before.
kevin: one more: update deprecation page with timeline 30-day shim then v1 sunset on Apr 25. I'll draft.
maria: perfect. thanks all :raised_hands:
